profile.features_intro: Your cloud drives on the Switch: browse files, stream videos, view photos, download to the SD card, and diagnose problems with the built-in network log. The active drive is always shown at the right end of the tab bar.

drives.title: Multiple drives
drives.detail: Quark, Aliyun, 115 and Baidu, switch with one press

login.title: QR sign-in
login.detail: Scan with your phone, credentials stay local

browse.title: File browsing
browse.detail: Grid and list views, sort by time or name

manage.title: File actions
manage.detail: New folder, rename, delete and move across folders

play.title: Video playback
play.detail: libmpv hardware decoding, direct or transcoded

speed.title: Playback speed
speed.detail: Press L3 for 0.5x - 2.0x, kept across sessions

quality.title: Quality
quality.detail: Press Y to pick Original, 4K, Ultra or HD

photo.title: Photos
photo.detail: Full-size images, L / R to page, B to go back

account.title: Account overview
account.detail: Avatar, nickname, membership and storage usage

cache.title: Cover cache
cache.detail: Thumbnails are cached on the SD card

log.title: Network log
log.detail: Built-in request log with status, no PC needed

profile.controls_intro: Every button, grouped by page. A " / " means both buttons do the same thing; R3 / L3 mean pressing the right / left stick.

keyguide.global_move: Move the focus, enter a folder or select a card
keyguide.global_back: Go back; pressing B on the root page asks whether to quit
keyguide.files_open: Open a folder, play a video or view an image
keyguide.files_more: More: rename, delete, move, download to this console
keyguide.downloads_select: Enter / leave multi-select, then delete in bulk
keyguide.downloads_delete: Delete the current record or the selected ones
keyguide.downloads_detail: Open task details; retry a failed task
keyguide.player_subtitle: Choose subtitles or turn them off
keyguide.player_playlist: Open the playlist (videos in the same folder)
keyguide.player_aspect: Toggle aspect ratio: original / stretch to fill
keyguide.player_exit: Exit playback and save the position
keyguide.log_open: Show request details and the response body

profile.about_tagline: Cloud drive client for Nintendo Switch
profile.about_text: A cloud drive browser and player for Nintendo Switch: Quark, Aliyun, 115 and Baidu drives, file browsing, video streaming with subtitles, photo viewing and a built-in network log for troubleshooting.
profile.about_thanks: Thanks to the open-source work of NXKit, borealis, libmpv and wiliwili.
profile.about_follow_hint: Scan in Douyin for updates and tips
